edges.parent_basis:
The state the decree reformed is the one the 1920 typical edition carried; that
is the book in use when it was issued, and the departures below are measured
against it. The decree is not a revision of a printing but of the rite the
printings held.

after.hour: in the morning, in choir after Terce
after.title: Dominica II Passionis seu in Palmis

before.hour: in the morning, in choir after Terce
before.title: Dominica in Palmis

cited.basis:
The decree names the day by its new title in the sentence that fixes when the
restored Order begins: `Novus hic Ordo servari debet a die 25 Martii, dominica
II Passionis seu in palmis, anni 1956` (aas-47-1955 51853-51854). The witness
prints it as the day's heading (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 34466-34468).

after.hour: vespere, non ante horam quintam post meridiem nec post horam octavam
after.title: Feria V in Coena Domini

cited.basis: Section 7 of the decree, aas-47-1955 51905-51908.

after.title: Feria VI in Passione et Morte Domini

before.hour: in the morning, in choir after None
before.title: Feria VI in Parasceve

cited.basis:
The decree's own words: `Feria VI in Passione et Morte Domini solemnis actio
liturgica celebratur horis postmeridianis` (aas-47-1955 51910-51911). The witness
prints the new title as the day's heading and in its running heads
(benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 38063, 38067-38068, 38129).
Section 8 of the decree, aas-47-1955 51910-51913; the witness at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 38079-38084 prints the same provision.

after.hour: circa mediam noctem inter sabbatum sanctum et dominicam Resurrectionis
after.title: Sabbato Sancto: De Vigilia paschali

cited.basis:
The day keeps its name and the liturgy within it is renamed: the decree speaks
of the `solemnis paschalis vigilia` (aas-47-1955 51915) and the witness prints
`SABBATO SANCTO` with `DE VIGILIA PASCHALI` beneath it
(benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 40187, 40195).

Section 9 of the decree, and this is the strongest single piece of evidence in
the file: the sentence at aas-47-1955 51915-51921 is reproduced word for word in
the witness at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 40203-40212. An act and a book
agreeing to the letter is a reception shown rather than assumed.

after.incipit: In illo tempore: Cum appropinquasset Jesus Jerosolymis
after.name: Sequentia sancti Evangelii secundum Matthaeum

before.incipit: In illo tempore: Cum appropinquasset Jesus Jerosolymis
before.name: Sequentia sancti Evangelii secundum Matthaeum

cited.basis:
The same Gospel, Matthew 21, 1-9, in a different place in the service. In the
pre-1955 witnesses it is read before the blessing prayers
(missale-romanum-1920 32017-32022, pustet-1862 28242-28247); in the 1962 witness
it stands after the distribution of palms, under its own heading DE LECTIONE
EVANGELICA (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 34784, 34800-34805).

before.incipit: Collegerunt pontifices et pharisaei consilium
before.name: Graduale

cited.basis: Not in the witness; `Colleg` returns nothing in benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 lines 34460-34870.

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Venerunt filii Israel in Elim
before.name: Lectio libri Exodi

cited.basis: Not in the witness; a search of benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 lines 34460-34870 for `Lectio` returns nothing.

before.incipit: Deus, quem diligere et amare justitia est
before.name: Oratio

cited.basis: Not in the witness. A whole-file search of benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 for `quem diligere` returns nothing, and the blessing there runs from the antiphon straight to a single blessing prayer at 34557.

before.incipit: Deus, qui dispersa congregas, et congregata conservas
before.name: Oratio

cited.basis: Not in the witness; `dispersa congr` returns nothing in benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962.

before.incipit: Deus, qui Filium tuum Jesum Christum, Dominum nostrum, pro salute nostra
before.name: Oratio

cited.basis: Not in the witness; the aspersion and incensation at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 34571-34587 are followed directly by the distribution heading at 34589.

before.incipit: Deus, qui miro dispositionis ordine, ex rebus etiam insensibilibus
before.name: Oratio

cited.basis: Not in the witness; `miro dispositi` returns nothing in benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962.

before.incipit: Deus, qui, per olivae ramum, pacem terris columbam nuntiare jussisti
before.name: Oratio

cited.basis: Not in the witness; `olivae ramum` returns nothing in benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962.

before.incipit: Petimus, Domine sancte, Pater omnipotens, aeterne Deus
before.name: Oratio

cited.basis: Not in the witness; a whole-file search of benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 for `Petimus, D` returns nothing.

before.incipit: Vere dignum et justum est
before.name: Praefatio

cited.basis: Not in the witness; `Vere dignum` returns nothing in benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 lines 34460-34870.

before.incipit: Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus Dominus Deus Sabaoth
before.name: Sanctus

cited.basis: Not in the witness; `Sanctus` returns nothing in benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 lines 34460-34870.

before.incipit: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum super pullum asinae sedere fecisti
before.name: Oratio

cited.basis: Not in the witness; `super pullum asin` returns nothing in benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962.

before.incipit: Agnus Dei non dicitur nec Postcommunio
before.name: Rubrica

cited.basis:
The rubric suppressing the Postcommunion is gone. The witness at
benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43388-43391 suppresses only the Agnus Dei and the
prayer Domine Iesu Christe, qui dixisti, and says nothing about a Postcommunion;
one is then printed at 43583.

after.incipit: In principio creavit Deus coelum et terram
after.name: Lectio prima

before.incipit: In principio creavit Deus coelum et terram
before.name: Prophetia Prima

cited.basis: Same reading, Gen. 1, 1-31 et 2, 1-2, under a new name and in a new series: benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41359, under the heading DE LECTIONIBUS at 41299. The word Prophetia does not occur anywhere in that book's Holy Week.

before.incipit: Noe vero cum quingentorum esset annorum
before.name: Prophetia Secunda

cited.basis: The witness prints four lessons where the pre-1955 books print twelve prophecies; Genesis 5-8 is not among them. benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41350-41351: `Leguntur vero quatuor sequentes lectiones, cum suis canticis, et orationibus.`

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Tentavit Deus Abraham
before.name: Prophetia Tertia

cited.basis: Genesis 22 is not among the four lessons at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41647.

after.incipit: In diebus illis: Factum est in vigilia matutina
after.name: Lectio secunda

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Factum est in vigilia matutina
before.name: Prophetia Quarta

cited.basis: Same reading, Ex. 14, 24-31 et 15, 1, now second of four: benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41510-41514.

before.incipit: Haec est hereditas servorum Domini
before.name: Prophetia Quinta

cited.basis: Isaiah 54-55 is not among the four lessons at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41647.

before.incipit: Audi, Israel, mandata vitae
before.name: Prophetia Sexta

cited.basis: Baruch 3 is not among the four lessons at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41647.

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Facta est super me manus Domini
before.name: Prophetia Septima

cited.basis: Ezechiel 37 is not among the four lessons at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41647.

after.incipit: In die illa erit germen Domini in magnificentia
after.name: Lectio tertia

before.incipit: Apprehendent septem mulieres virum unum in die illa
before.name: Prophetia Octava

cited.basis: Same reading, Isaiah 4, now third of four: benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41581-41585.

The same chapter, shortened at the front. The pre-1955 books print Is. 4, 1-6
beginning `Apprehendent septem mulieres` (missale-romanum-1920 39468-39472); the
witness prints `I s . 4, 2-6` beginning `Tn die illa erit germen D6mini in
magnific6ntia` (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41583-41585). Verse 1 is gone. This
is the one departure in the file where a unit both moves and changes, and it is
recorded as two rows because they are two different claims.

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Dixit Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron
before.name: Prophetia Nona

cited.basis: Exodus 12 is not among the four lessons at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41647.

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Factum est verbum Domini ad Jonam
before.name: Prophetia Decima

cited.basis: Jonah 3 is not among the four lessons at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41647.

after.incipit: In diebus illis: Scripsit Moyses canticum
after.name: Lectio quarta

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Scripsit Moyses canticum
before.name: Prophetia Undecima

cited.basis: Same reading, Deut. 31, 22-30, now fourth of four: benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41643-41647.

before.incipit: In diebus illis: Nabuchodonosor rex fecit statuam auream
before.name: Prophetia Duodecima

cited.basis: Daniel 3 is not among the four lessons at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41355-41647.

before.incipit: Alleluja, alleluja, alleluja
before.name: Antiphona ad Vesperas

cited.basis:
The office that follows the Mass changes from Vespers to Lauds. The pre-1955
witnesses sing it `pro Vesperis in Choro` with Ps. 116 (missale-romanum-1920
41415-41446); the 1962 witness sings it `pro LAUDIBUS dominicae Resurrectionis`
with Ps. 150 (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43393-43396, 43420). The antiphon's own
words were not read in the 1962 witness and are carried forward unchanged, which
is a weaker claim than the slot change and is why the two are separate rows.

before.incipit: Vespere autem sabbati
before.name: Antiphona ad Magnificat

cited.basis: The canticle changes with the hour: Magnificat in the pre-1955 witnesses (missale-romanum-1920 41449-41460), Benedictus in the 1962 witness (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43466-43482).
The witness prints `T VALDE ma-ne` at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43482, the Benedictus antiphon of Easter morning, where the pre-1955 books print `Vespere autem sabbati`.

after.incipit: Spiritum nobis, Domine, tuae caritatis infunde
after.name: Postcommunio seu Oratio
after.text:
Spiritum nobis, Domine, tuae caritatis infunde: ut, quos sacramentis paschalibus
satiasti, tua facias pietate concordes. Per Dominum ... in unitate ejusdem.

before.incipit: Spiritum nobis, Domine, tuae caritatis infunde
before.name: Oratio
before.text:
Spiritum nobis, Domine, tuae caritatis infunde: ut, quos sacramentis paschalibus
satiasti, tua facias pietate concordes. Per Dominum ... in unitate ejusdem.

cited.basis:
The case this tracer was built to carry. The words do not change. In the
pre-1955 witnesses they are the Oratio of the short Vespers sung after the Holy
Saturday Mass, in a service whose own rubric says the Mass has no Postcommunion
(missale-romanum-1920 41411-41413, 41564-41580; pustet-1862 36945-36948,
36993-37004). In the 1962 witness the same words stand under the heading
`Postcommunio seu Oratio` at the end of Lauds (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962
43583-43589). A matcher keyed on (mass, proper-name) asks a pre-reform book for
a Postcommunion, gets nothing, and writes down an absence; that false absence is
already recorded in this repository at
src/sources/inventories/roman-1962-proper-translations-v1.toml and was refuted
against the page on 2026-07-31.
